# Five isolated whole-workload cohorts — source-only draft

No builds, samples or dispatch have run for this package. Activation requires root
source approval, immutable publication and explicit dispatch. `plan.json` rejects
execution while DRAFT. The approved dispatch SHA must equal actual workflow SHA;
same-run transport binds that SHA without a self-referential committed SHA literal.

The fixed partition is [0,7,9], [1,2,3,13], [5,6,11], [4,8,14], [10,12,15]. Each
workload's two arms, both orders, startup/calibration, pilot and four long blocks
run entirely on one VM. The union retains 704 rows, 16 workloads and 48 metric
outcomes. No distribution or ratio is pooled across VMs. Original assessor,
bootstrap seed/count, five-CPU-second long target, calibration, pilot stability,
iterations cap and 90 physical inputs are unchanged. The original unsuitable
2x8 proposal and every historical adverse/partial result remain immutable.

Historical cohort child durations are 431–461 seconds, not a current fit promise.
Each sampler has a hard 600-second deadline and requires 65 seconds before every
child (original 60-second child bound plus five cleanup seconds). The controller
also anchors to the official current job `started_at`, reserving 180 seconds from
its 30-minute whole-job budget and requiring 720 seconds before sampling. All
partial outputs survive failure. There is no host-wide quiet lease or reservation.

The bootstrap job copies the published 32e9 credential boundary: no checkout or
repository/native execution, only eight fixed draft asset GETs and SHA/size checks.
Eight sequential 100-second subprocess limits fit a 15-minute step/18-minute job.
Measurement jobs are read-only; token variables are removed before native commands.
The actual safe transport worked for #2076, but this new eight-asset/five-VM
adaptation remains unexecuted.

Actual binary producers stay baseline c896 and candidate4c; e0/b9 source equivalence
and successful b9 TestCI38946788247 are retained in the original local source proof.
Proper fullLTO/cgu1 helpers come from the genuine closed matched producers. No new
compiler, artifact or performance claim is made. All24 genuine compiler layouts
and independent root readback are pinned, not synthesized from sizes in source.

Each VM reruns the immutable current full182 collector/all27 groups and both SQL
API scripts on both actual addons (1 and34 passes, zero skipped). The collector
adapter changes only obsolete Git lookup revision IDs to authentic c896/4c in
memory, never its normalization or expected report hashes. Payload source files
are hash-verified before materialization; existing checkout files must match.

`workflow.yml` always uploads O and ROOT/public, ROOT/private and the two semantic
manifests. It excludes ELF transfer symlinks, source Git stores, tokens and environment
dumps. The controller records an explicit retained-file inventory even on failure.
After independently checking official artifact digests, root may run
`union-from-artifacts.py --artifact <cohort0> ... --artifact <cohort4> --output <new>`.
It rehashes retained files, reopens all910 fresh semantic raw files, verifies all704
rows and recomputes unchanged workload-local statistics. Numerical outcomes remain
separate from integrity and require root review; higher/inconclusive is never PASS.

Source validation: `python3 -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py'` (11 methods),
plus actionlint with actual ShellCheck. Synthetic saved archive bytes are explicitly
labeled SYNTHETIC and cannot substitute for runtime receipts. One first unit attempt
used a text-read mock against a bytes-read call; the failed source is retained and
the corrected bytes-read mutation rejects the missing row.
